definitions.explanation: The outer walls of a building that protect the interior from weather and provide structural support.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}げて→剥げる：29715_hageru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The paint on the exterior wall has started to peel.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：noentry⟧⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{組|く}まれて→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Scaffolding has been set up for the exterior wall work.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{断熱|だんねつ}{材|ざい}→断熱材：08079_dannetsuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To install insulation in the exterior wall.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) + {壁|へき} (wall). Literally "outside wall."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外壁|がいへき}⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧ (exterior wall painting)
- {外壁|がいへき}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (exterior wall construction/repair)
- {外壁|がいへき}⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧ (exterior wall renovation)
- ⟦{外壁|がいへき}{材|ざい}→外壁材：noentry⟧ (exterior wall material)
- {外壁|がいへき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{亀裂|きれつ}→亀裂：09411_kiretsu⟧/⟦ひび→ひび：noentry⟧ (cracks in the exterior wall)

COMMON MATERIALS:
- ⟦サイディング→サイディング：29717_saidingu⟧ (siding)
- ⟦モルタル→モルタル：29718_morutaru⟧ (mortar)
- ⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧ (tile)
- ⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧ (concrete)

- ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧ (interior decoration)
